action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Supabase RLS policies for 'users' table - The logged-in user cannot access it, causing cascade failures in CMS operations
The createArticle function in /app/frontend/lib/supabase/cms.js tries to reference users table during article creation
Check RLS policies on: cms_articles, content_blocks, media_assets, authors, categories, tags tables
Consider adding a policy that allows authenticated users to read from the users table or modify the CMS functions to not depend on it
Add user-visible error handling when Save Draft fails - currently fails silently
critical_code_review_comments: Supabase RLS policies need configuration to allow authenticated users proper access to CMS tables
The error 'permission denied for table users' indicates the users table needs SELECT policy for authenticated users
Consider separating user profile data from sensitive user data with different RLS policies

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login works. CMS UI pages render correctly. Article creation fails with Supabase RLS error code 42501 'permission denied for table users'. Main agent needs to fix RLS policies before CMS workflow can be fully tested. Session persistence issue when navigating directly to editor pages.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies on the 'users' table are not configured to allow authenticated users to read from it. The CMS operations (article creation, loading articles, loading media) depend on querying user data, which triggers the permission denied error.
reproduction_steps: 3. Fill in article title and summary
5. Console shows error: {code: 42501, details: null, hint: null, message: permission denied for table users}
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Add RLS policy to users table: CREATE POLICY 'Allow authenticated users to read users' ON users FOR SELECT USING (auth.role() = 'authenticated');
